description: Explain available review options only after the user confirms the actual decision stage and ordinary modernized-review eligibility. Initial/Supplemental, HLR and final Board decisions have different options; preferences do not establish eligibility. Unknown, legacy, contested, remand-only and pending-review contexts withhold tailored lanes. No personal deadline calculation. Educational only.

decision_stage.description: Actual stage explicitly identified by the user from their own notice. Never infer from a denial, hearing preference, or historical decision.

eligible_review_context_confirmed.description: True only when the user confirms an ordinary modernized, non-contested issue within the applicable review window, with no pending review, motion or special exception. False or omitted withholds tailored lanes. This does not verify a filing deadline.

has_new_evidence.description: Does the veteran have new, relevant evidence to add?

wants_hearing.description: Does the veteran want a hearing before a judge? This never makes a Board appeal available.

name: explain_appeal_options

link.description: Tagged deep link into the matching veterans-rights.com page.
